body:
Combines Silver UI + Lock-on + Bow Aim + Translucent (Nexus 39) with UI Icon Remake (Nexus 667) into one texture pack — Silver UI's skin and translucent panels, the Icon Remake's icons and menu art — plus subjective hand edits: several panels and menu elements were replaced and recomposed, so it is not a straight copy of either original. Install with DSR-TPUP: point its Texture Override at the packed `Texture Override` folder, click Pack.

把 Silver UI（Nexus 39）和 UI Icon Remake（Nexus 667）合成一个贴图包：皮肤与半透明面板用 Silver UI，图标与菜单美术用 UI Icon Remake；并结合时做了主观修改——手动替换、重拼了若干面板与元素，不是任一原包的照搬。用 DSR-TPUP 安装：Texture Override 指向包里的 `Texture Override` 文件夹，点 Pack。

All art belongs to those two packs' authors.
